fields.description: What the list shows. Data rather than a Link: the doctype belongs to a tenant site and need not exist here.
fields.label: Doctype

fields.description: Comma-separated fieldnames for the columns. Labels and types come from the tenant site's own metadata, so this is the only thing worth writing down. Empty shows the doctype's own list fields.
fields.label: Fields

fields.description: Escape hatch: a component the SPA registered under `spaceCode/screen`. Set this and the doctype above is ignored.
fields.label: Component

fields.description: Hide New on this screen even where the doctype allows one to be made. For a screen that reads records something else writes.
fields.label: Never offer New

fields.description: Which field says where a record stands — the one whose value goes on the badge beside a record's name. A fieldname, checked against the doctype like any other; the colours are the doctype's own Document States, not something to repeat here. Empty is no badge.
fields.label: Status Field

fields.description: How this screen may be looked at, in order — `list`, `board`, `calendar`, `grid`, `map`. The first is what it opens with. Anything the SPA does not build yet is ignored rather than refused, so a manifest can name one before it ships.
fields.label: View Types

fields.description: Per type, what that type needs: {"board": {"column_field": "status"}, "calendar": {"start_field": "date"}}. Every fieldname in here is checked against the doctype like any other.
fields.label: View Settings
